name: Judah
description: Man living at the time of Exile and Return

source.name: TIPNR, Translators Individualised Proper Names with all References, by Tyndale House Cambridge, STEPBible.org

cases.name: Judah robbing God in tithes and offerings
cases.charge: Going away from the Lord’s ordinances and not keeping them; robbing God in tithes and offerings, so that there was no meat in His house and the Levites fled every one to his field
cases.preview: From the days of their fathers Judah had gone away from the Lord’s ordinances, and when He called them to return and they asked how, He answered that they had robbed Him in tithes and offerings…
